# Change handover

Run/specification/evidence versions:
Candidate revision and dirty state:
Status:

## Delivered and excluded

Explain the player/contributor outcome without claiming unverified functionality.

## Evidence

AC results, build/test/review output, browser/manual checks and limitations.

## Remaining risks and release blockers

List pending human decisions and owned unknowns, including required Unverified checks.

## Operations and rollback

Link the approved procedure, or mark Unknown. No release without G5.

## Decisions requested

Request G4 from the product owner; do not infer acceptance.
G5 is separate and cannot be requested until blockers are cleared.
